full_prompt_en: A square oil portrait shows a seated young woman in a black dress, resting the side of her face against one raised hand. She turns slightly toward the viewer but lets her gaze drift downward, making the pose introspective rather than formal. Her short dark hair is gathered neatly behind the ears, with a large round green earring visible on one side. The face and exposed arm are painted in warm ivory with coral cheeks, small red lips, and blue-green shadow along the neck and jaw. A curved honey-brown chair back frames the left side of her body. Her dress forms a deep, nearly black mass in the lower half, relieved by thin pale edging around the neckline and flashes of patterned fabric at the sleeves. Behind her, a densely patterned floral wall or textile fills the field with yellow flowers, orange circles, tangled green leaves, teal curls, and navy outlines. The ornament presses forward almost to the same visual plane as the sitter, so figure and background interlock rather than separate into deep perspective. Brushstrokes remain visible and lively: broad dark swipes shape the dress, short broken marks model skin, and quick curving strokes describe foliage and petals. Saturated yellow, turquoise, green, and orange surround the quiet black figure; repeated blue-green accents connect the earring and skin shadows to the background. Illumination is broad and even, giving the face a soft glow without a strong cast shadow. The composition balances a calm, carefully observed human presence against a restless decorative surface, with the bent arm and chair curve creating a gentle circular rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形油画肖像表现一名身着黑裙的年轻女子坐着，将侧脸倚在抬起的一只手上。她身体微转向观者，目光却低低漂开，使姿势沉思而非正式。短深发整齐收在耳后，一侧可见大而圆的绿耳环。脸与裸露手臂以暖象牙色描绘，带珊瑚红脸颊、小红唇和颈颌处的蓝绿色阴影。蜂蜜褐色弯椅背框住身体左侧。裙装在下半部形成深沉近黑大块，只由领口纤细浅边和袖上几处花纹布闪现打破。身后，密集繁花墙面或织物以黄花、橙色圆形、缠绕绿叶、青绿曲线和海军蓝轮廓填满画幅。装饰几乎前推到与人物同一视觉平面，人物与背景互相嵌合，而不分离成深透视。笔触可见而活跃：宽暗色扫痕塑造裙装，短促断笔刻出肌肤，迅速的曲笔描绘叶与花瓣。饱和黄、蓝绿、绿和橙环绕安静的黑衣形体；重复蓝绿重点将耳环和肌肤阴影接到背景。光照宽广均匀，让脸柔和发亮，而无强烈投影。构图以安静细察的人物和躁动的装饰表面相平衡，弯曲手臂与椅背弧线形成温柔循环节奏。
style_prompt_en: Expressive oil painting joins solid observed forms to a crowded decorative field. Broad nearly black masses anchor the lower area, while saturated yellow, turquoise, leaf green, orange, and navy curl and repeat through a dense upper pattern. Visible brushwork alternates between sweeping dark strokes, short broken marks on pale rounded surfaces, and quick sinuous lines inside floral-like ornament. Warm ivory passages carry coral accents and cool blue-green shadows, linking focal forms to the surrounding colors. Contours are confident but not mechanically sharp, with small irregularities and pigment grain left apparent. Light is broad and soft, allowing color contrast and brush direction to build volume without theatrical shadow. The shallow space presses patterned ground and foreground close together; a curved framing arc and a bent diagonal guide the eye around a calm central mass amid busy rhythmic detail.
style_prompt_zh: 富表现力的油画把扎实观察的形体与拥挤装饰色域接合。宽阔近黑大块锚定下部，饱和黄、蓝绿、叶绿、橙与海军蓝在上方密集图案里弯曲重复。可见笔触在横扫深色笔痕、浅色圆浑表面的短断笔、花卉般装饰内部的迅速蜿蜒线之间交替。暖象牙色区域带珊瑚重点和冷蓝绿阴影，使焦点形体与周围颜色相连。轮廓自信却非机械锐利，保留小不规则与颜料颗粒。光线宽广柔和，让色彩反差和笔方向建立体积，而不用舞台化阴影。浅空间把图案底面和前景压近；弯曲的框架弧与折转对角引导目光绕着繁忙细节中的安静中心转动。
theme_en: A seated woman in a dark dress rests her cheek on one hand before a floral backdrop
theme_zh: 身着深色裙装、托腮坐在繁花背景前的女子
name: Suzanne Valadon
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
